brief:
Arab and Muslim leaders addressed the UN General Assembly on its second day, focusing heavily on the US-Israel war on Iran and the genocide in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The speeches centered on what the leaders characterized as militarism engulfing the region.

The statements reflected ongoing regional tensions and the humanitarian toll of current conflicts, with speakers denouncing military escalation across the Middle East.
dek: UN General Assembly 2026: Arab and Muslim leaders denounce militarism engulfing region Arab and Muslim leaders once again focused heavily on the US-Israel war on Iran and the genocide in Gaza on the second day of the United Nations General Assembly.
title: Arab and Muslim leaders condemn regional militarism at UN General Assembly
